mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 66 degrees.

In city news, please be aware that a segment of Highway M near the new Aldi site will be closed for road work from October 6 through October 9, with traffic detoured to Old PB and Main Street. Additionally, residents can begin early in-person voting for the November 3 election at City Hall starting October 20.

There is a lot happening today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory, with live music coming up at Bailey's Run Vineyard this Friday.

In a noteworthy update from the police department, officers were dispatched on September 21 to a retailer on East Verona Avenue where a suspect was identified via video surveillance and subsequently cited for the retail theft of Swedish Fish.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for a scoop of Double Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain ready to serve you until 10:00 PM tonight.
